What products did y'all use up this month?

Here are the things I used up/destashed this month

I really want to get a few higher end perfumes (Michael Kors Collection Sexy Amber and Marc Jacobs Daisy Blush); as a result I am trying to use up some of my old body sprays before I allow myself to splurge. I used up all of my bath and body works dream romance spray. I've had it forever, and I am surprised it still smelled good. I loved it and I would consider buying it again, however they don't make it anymore. :( The black raspberry vanilla perfume smelled "off" so I am tossing it. Which I hate! I hate wasting things. They don't make that one anymore either so no repurchase here!

I used a LOT of lotion this month. The Bath and body works Coconut Lime breeze is one of my husbands favorite scents and it does leave my skin feeling soft. So I will probably repurchase this again to wear at night on my arms and legs when he gets back from deployment later this year. The Argan oil body butter was a gift and it was just "okay" as far as moisture goes. Nothing to write home about; although, I did really like the lilac scent. I probably won't purchase this. The wish body butter was included in an Ulta sample bag. It was pretty moisturizing, but the smell reminded me of cigarettes for some reason after it was on my skin for a while. I won't be buying this based on the awful scent. I may try some other scents in the future.

As for make up, I used up an entire Lorac Cobra Travel Mascara. I love this stuff. It's very natural looking, doesn't flake or smudge on me. So far its my favorite mascara. I will repurchase this in the future when I use up some other mascaras. The Two Faced better than sex travel mascara, smelled off, so I am tossing it. I rarely used it because I'm in the minority that does not like this mascara. It flakes on me and irritates my eyes. I won't be repurchasing. The pan is a Mary-Loumanizer highlighter. I had hit pan a while ago, and it broke apart recently in my z-pallete so I just decided not to worry about repressing it and toss it. I used it pretty regularly the last three years and felt like I got my moneys worth anyways. While I do like the formula, I probably won't be repurchasing because it is just too strong of a highlight for most of my looks. But I would recommend it to someone who wanted a very visible/strong highlight.

And last but not least a drug store polish remover. It did its job, what more can I say :-p and Batiste Dry shampoo in "wild". I hate the cheetah packaging but Its my favorite scent from the line, so I will definitely be buying this again. It is my favorite dry shampoo formula! :)
